value.rationale: This normalized imaginary cross-spectrum vanishes exactly at equilibrium despite nonzero conventional complex-coherence magnitude, so it is a time-arrow-sensitive observable. The unique intrinsic optimal frequency and the strictly unattainable temperature-contrast-only maximal amplitude give quantitative, physically motivated bounds and a design benchmark for the entire stable two-bath harmonic family. It is not merely arbitrary parameter substitution or a known table; finite-sample experimental design remains unproved.
